cases.description: Real anchor (HB 1111). A numbered marker '(2)' following a lettered list '(a)/(b)' is a new subsection, not a continuation — the expiration sentence must not be welded onto the board's duty.
cases.sentence: The board shall prioritize hearings on petitions for early release, in the following descending order with the highest priority given to: (a) Petitioners under the age of 25 in the custody of the department of children, youth, and families; and (b) Petitioners in the custody of the department of corrections. (2) This section expires July 1, 2035.

unitChecks.actionContains: Petitioners in the custody of the department of corrections

cases.description: Real anchor shape (HB 1111, two-actor and-split feeding into the lettered list). The department's and the board's duties must both still render, with no welding of the expiration sentence onto either.
cases.sentence: Within the limit of 70 petitions per year, the department shall prioritize examinations, and the board shall prioritize hearings in the following order: (a) Petitioners under 25; and (b) Petitioners in custody. (2) This section expires July 1, 2035.

cases.description: Regression guard: a lettered marker '(c)' following '(a)'/'(b)' in the same list is a genuine same-level continuation and must still inherit the lead-in, exactly as before this fix.
cases.sentence: The board shall prioritize hearings in the following order: (a) Petitioners under 25; and (b) Petitioners in custody. (c) Petitioners aged 30 and over.

cases.description: Regression guard: an ordinary following sentence with its own duty and no marker at all must render as its own separate provision, unaffected by the list boundary fix.
cases.sentence: The board shall prioritize hearings in the following order: (a) Petitioners under 25; and (b) Petitioners in custody. The department shall submit a report by December 1, 2026.

cases.description: Regression guard: same as above, but the following sentence also carries a numbered marker '(3)' — since it has its own modal, it was never a binding candidate either way, but confirms the new outline-level check doesn't disturb it.
cases.sentence: The board shall prioritize hearings in the following order: (a) Petitioners under 25; and (b) Petitioners in custody. (3) The department shall submit a report by December 1, 2026.

cases.sentence: The board shall prioritize hearings in the following order: (1) Petitioners under 25. (2) Petitioners in custody.
